snippet.title: Gulltastrophe - Introduction Trailer
snippet.description:
Gulltastrophe is a 3D tactical seagull action game where you play as a seagull!

Humans have taken over your island as a vacation spot. Fly, Dash, and Poop on people. Kick all of them out and take back your island!

🚂 Wishlist on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3532810/Gulltastrophe
